def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species case variant
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix island leading-space variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].count()
    return {k: int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
